summary: Mode-dependent session state reset. When the init flag at obj+0x1D0 is not 1, clears obj+0x3FC4 to 0. When the global init guard byte_7CE260 is clear and dword_7D0410 equals 5 (championship mode), clamps the player count into dword_7D0A44 from dword_7D0A4C/dword_7D0A50 and the vehicle count into dword_7D0990 from dword_7D0998/dword_7D099C; otherwise the state at obj+0x3FC4 is reset to 0. Called by Game_Setup.

local_names.result: current object pointer (this[0]) or last clamped value

operations.description: If the field at obj+0x1D0 is NOT equal to 1, reset the state field obj+0x3FC4 to 0.
Mode-dependent setup is skipped entirely when the global init-guard byte_7CE260 is non-zero.
Enter the configuration branch only when global dword_7D0410 equals 5 (championship mode).
Clamp the player count: dword_7D0A44 is set to 0, then to dword_7D0A4C when that is positive, else to dword_7D0A50 when dword_7D0A4C is not positive and dword_7D0A50 is negative.
Clamp the vehicle count: dword_7D0990 is set to 0, then to dword_7D0998 when that is positive, else to dword_7D099C when dword_7D0998 is not positive and dword_7D099C is negative.
Else branch (mode not 5): reset the state field obj+0x3FC4 to 0.
Return the object pointer read from this[0] (or the last clamp source value assigned to result).

unresolved: The ABI label 'Season_Championship_State_Init' is LEGACY and the actual object type behind this[0] is unnamed; owner stays UNKNOWN.
